summary: Diana Shipping Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for July 2026. The filing attaches an investor presentation dated July 30, 2026, as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation event is described in the filing text; it is a routine current report providing an investor presentation. There are no disclosed transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors. The filing is purely informational and does not indicate any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. The registrant's role is as the filer of this periodic report.
